retrievalProfile.description: A 1950s-style portrait featuring a clean-cut male vocalist with an acoustic guitar against a vertically split red and blue background with bold slab-serif text.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male singer with styled dark hair, holding an acoustic guitar. The composition is defined by a sharp vertical division in the background between a vibrant red left panel and a soft blue right panel, with high-contrast yellow typography stacked on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between color-blocked background panels
Guitar neck creates a strong vertical line on the right third
Typography aligned to the left edge within the red panel
Warm skin tones and red vest contrasting against the cool blue background
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject is centered, waist-up, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright yellow text on the red background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text on the left, move to the subject's face, and follow the guitar neck down to the body of the instrument.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject, instrument, and large-scale text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and yellow; medium value in the blue; naturalistic skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with condensed proportions
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight modulation

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the red background panel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family dominance with small sans-serif metadata in corners.
graphicDevices: Rectangular logo badge in top right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and blocky appearance.
Provides the correct mid-century geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a 1950s male singer with a pompadour, wearing a white shirt and red vest, holding an acoustic guitar. The background should be vertically split: the left half solid vibrant red, the right half soft sky blue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, uppercase slab-serif text in golden yellow to the top left red section. Add a small blue rectangular logo badge in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background split vertically between red and blue?
Is the text a heavy slab serif in yellow?
Is the subject's hair styled in a 1950s pompadour?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible and correctly aligned to the left.
The red vest matches the red background panel hue.
The guitar neck is vertical and provides a compositional anchor.
The lighting is soft and flattering without harsh shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (1950s male vocalist) + Instrument (Acoustic Guitar) + Background (Vertical Red/Blue Split) + Typography (Stacked Yellow Slab Serif).
